title: The_Incident_Is_Real_e0d481d4
style: Industrial metal with heavy electronic influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and syncopated power chords. Aggressive male vocals alternate between melodic grit and harsh screams. The drum kit features a punchy, compressed snare and rapid double-kick patterns. Synthesizers provide high-pitched, dissonant leads and rhythmic pulses. The bass guitar is heavily distorted, doubling the guitar riffs. 160 BPM, 4/4 time signature, key of D minor.
